description: This is a header file defining the API for a text-based commit graph visualization in a version control system. It includes function declarations for initializing, updating, and rendering the graph, as well as setting visual styles and handling commit data.

methods.name: graph_setup_line_prefix
methods.description: Sets up the display of line prefixes based on diff options, to be used before graph initialization.

methods.name: graph_set_column_colors
methods.description: Configures a custom color scheme for graph columns, allowing use of ANSI escapes or HTML, must be called before graph_init.

methods.name: graph_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new git_graph structure based on revision info.

methods.name: graph_clear
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a git_graph structure.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph with a new commit, preparing it for subsequent line rendering.

methods.name: graph_is_commit_finished
methods.description: Checks if all lines for the current commit have been output.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Outputs the next line of the graph into a strbuf for rendering, indicating if the line contains the current commit.

methods.name: graph_width
methods.description: Returns the current width of the graph in on-screen characters.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Prints the entire commit's history graph to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Prints one line of the graph to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Prints vertical padding for the graph line.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Prints the remaining part of the current commit's graph to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Prints the commit message and the rest of the graph to a given FILE stream.
